items.headline: U.S. Equities Rally on Strong Earnings and Easing Geopolitical Tensions
items.summary: U.S. stock markets posted broad gains today, with the Dow Jones Industrial Average closing at a new all-time high and the S&P 500 and Nasdaq Composite advancing significantly. The rally was fueled by robust quarterly earnings reports, particularly from AI-related companies, and optimism surrounding a potential de-escalation of Middle East tensions, which contributed to a notable drop in oil prices and eased inflation concerns.

items.headline: Palantir Soars on Blockbuster Earnings
items.summary: Palantir Technologies ($PLTR) skyrocketed, with shares up +28.88% in today's session, following the release of blockbuster quarterly results and a raised full-year outlook.

items.headline: Wayfair Jumps After Exceeding Earnings Expectations
items.summary: Online retailer Wayfair ($W) surged, gaining +32.36% today, after reporting second-quarter earnings that beat Wall Street's expectations.

items.headline: Zebra Technologies Rises on Strong Q2 Performance
items.summary: Zebra Technologies ($ZBRA) saw its stock climb +22.82% after the barcode scanner maker surpassed second-quarter earnings estimates.

items.headline: Aethlon Medical Posts Massive Single-Session Gain
items.summary: Aethlon Medical ($AEMD) experienced an extraordinary surge, gaining +403.0% in a single session.

items.headline: Certara Tumbles on Missed Earnings
items.summary: Certara ($CERT) tumbled by 23.7% after the biosimulation and drug development software company missed Wall Street's second-quarter earnings expectations.

items.headline: Game Your Game Experiences Significant Decline
items.summary: Shares of Game Your Game ($GYGY) fell -31.3% in today's trading session.

items.headline: Technology and AI Lead Market Gains
items.summary: The technology sector, particularly AI-centric stocks, drove today's market rally, with strong performances from giants like Palantir and positive forecasts from companies like ON Semiconductor. This signals continued investor confidence in the AI boom, benefiting related industries such as equipment for data centers.

items.headline: Consumer Discretionary, Communication Services, and Energy Sectors Post Gains
items.summary: Alongside technology, the Consumer Discretionary, Communication Services, and Energy Select Sector SPDRs saw gains of 3.3%, 1.6%, and 1%, respectively. The Banking & Investment Services sector also moved up by 0.94%. In contrast, the Materials Select Sector SPDR tumbled 2.3%.

items.headline: Manufacturing Activity Expands; Trade Deficit Narrows
items.summary: The Institute of Supply Management reported that the manufacturing Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) for July reached 55.6, its best monthly reading since May 2022, indicating robust expansion. Separately, the U.S. goods and services deficit narrowed to $73.3 billion in June, down $4.4 billion from May.

items.headline: Key Earnings Reports Drive Individual Stock Moves
items.summary: Caterpillar Inc. ($CAT) reported stronger-than-expected Q2 profit and revenue, marking its first quarter with over $20 billion in sales. DigitalOcean ($DOCN) also announced strong Q2 results and raised its 2026 revenue outlook. Investors are now anticipating earnings reports from Advanced Micro Devices ($AMD) and SpaceX ($SPCX) after the market close.

items.headline: Falling Oil Prices and Easing Geopolitical Tensions Boost Confidence
items.summary: Oil prices declined today, with West Texas Intermediate futures settling down 5.1% to $80.34 per barrel, driven by hopes for a U.S.-Iran agreement to reopen the Strait of Hormuz. This, coupled with easing geopolitical tensions, helped allay inflation concerns and bolstered overall market sentiment.
